brief: Goldman Sachs Prime Services' intraday hedge fund monitor for October 30, 2026, at noon EST. Markets sold off broadly, led by Tech, with the Nasdaq 100 down more than 3%; momentum and growth factors underperformed. Global Fundamental long/short managers fell 1.2% (-1.8 SD), driven primarily by beta and Info Tech exposure, taking them to -3.6% month-to-date while still up 9% year-to-date. Within that group, Asia-focused funds fell 1.2% (-1 SD) to -9.5% MTD (still +14% YTD), and TMT-focused funds fell 3.8% (-2.6 SD) to -12.6% MTD, cutting their YTD gain to 5.1%. Global Systematic long/short managers fell a smaller 0.6% (-1.5 SD): losses in Asia and Europe were partially offset by gains in the US, with momentum, crowding and short-term-signal strategies the main drags. Systematic managers are now down 3.5% MTD, on track for their first negative month of the year, but remain up 16% YTD. The note reports these estimates without offering a forward view.
